observations.right_opening_1: A high narrow window is clearly visible on the target right wall and can support a local opening-size cue after rectification.
observations.right_opening_3: The lower translucent opening is visually consistent with a four-column glass-block grid; the count is benchmark-side inferred evidence, not Survey truth.
observations.utility_pole: The electrical pole occludes the right side and is external context, never a house edge or scale object.
observations.rear_boundary: Photo 2 does not prove that the visible rectified wall segment reaches the target building's true rear boundary.

decision.reason: A feature/reference ratio only estimates the physical extent represented by its reference plane. Without evidence that the reference spans the complete front-to-rear target extent, using it as volume_main.depth would silently turn partial visibility into full geometry.

next_generic_requirement: Scale cue bindings need explicit provenance for what architectural extent the reference region represents, including a completeness/coverage gate before an absolute Scene dimension may be resolved.
